title: Terms of Use
summary: DomEase helps you plan meals, share cleaning and keep one shopping list. Use it for your own home, keep your sign in safe, and treat the people you share it with fairly. Meal and dietary ideas are general guidance, not medical advice. Premium is paid by mobile money and you can stop it at any time.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: DomEase ("DomEase", "we", "us") is a home management app operated from Kampala, Uganda. These Terms are an agreement between you and DomEase about your use of the DomEase mobile app and website (together, the "Service").
Questions about these Terms can be sent to hello@domease.app.

sections.heading: Agreeing to these Terms
paragraphs: By creating an account or using the Service you agree to these Terms and to our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the Service.
You must be 18 or older to create an account. DomEase is made for adults who run a home; it is not directed at children.

sections.heading: Your account
paragraphs: You can sign in with Google, Apple, a phone number or an email address. Keep your sign in details safe and tell us at once if you think someone else has used your account.
The details you give us must be true and kept up to date. You are responsible for what happens under your account.
You can delete your account at any time from You, then Profile, then Delete account.

sections.heading: Your home and the people in it
paragraphs: When you set up a home you are its owner. With Premium you can invite others to join it with an invite code. Everyone in a home can see and change its meals, cleaning rota and shopping list.
Only add people to your home, or details about them such as names, age groups or allergies, if you have the right to do so. Do not add anyone without their knowledge.

sections.heading: Using the Service fairly
paragraphs: Do not use the Service to break the law, to harm or harass anyone, to send spam, or to upload anything that is offensive or that you do not have the right to share.
Do not try to copy, reverse engineer, overload or get around the security of the Service, or use it to build a competing product.
We may suspend or close an account that breaks these Terms. Where it is fair to do so we will tell you first and give you a chance to put things right.

sections.heading: Recipes and suggestions you send us
paragraphs: If you suggest a recipe or an idea, you confirm it is yours to share and you allow DomEase to review, edit, publish and use it in the Service without payment. We may decide not to publish a suggestion.

sections.heading: Meals, health and dietary ideas
paragraphs: Recipes, meal plans, nudges and dietary suggestions, including diabetic and PCOS friendly ideas, are general guidance only. They are not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
Always check ingredients for allergies, and speak to a doctor or dietitian about your own health needs. Our Health and dietary notice explains this in more detail.

sections.heading: House Help guides and vetting
paragraphs: The House Help guides and the vetting questionnaire help you think through hiring someone to work in your home. The fit score is a guide, not a decision. You remain responsible for any hiring decision and for meeting the law on employment in Uganda, including fair pay and treatment.

sections.heading: Premium
paragraphs: Most of DomEase is free. Premium adds extra features and removes advertising. Prices, billing and cancellation are explained in Premium and payments, which forms part of these Terms.

sections.heading: Advertising
paragraphs: The free plan shows a small number of advertisements, provided by Google AdMob. We do not show adverts on Premium.

sections.heading: Our content
paragraphs: The DomEase name, logo, app, recipes, guides and design belong to DomEase or our licensors. You may use them only to use the Service for your own home.

sections.heading: Changes to the Service
paragraphs: We keep improving DomEase, so features may change. If we make a change that significantly reduces what Premium includes, we will tell you in advance.

sections.heading: Liability
paragraphs: We work hard to keep DomEase accurate and available, but the Service is provided as it is and we cannot promise it will always be error free or uninterrupted.

Nothing in these Terms limits any rights you have under the law of Uganda that cannot be limited. Otherwise, DomEase is not responsible for losses that were not reasonably foreseeable, or for losses caused by your own use of meals, recipes or guidance without the care described above. Our total liability to you is limited to the amount you paid us for Premium in the twelve months before the claim.

sections.heading: Changes to these Terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms. If a change is important we will tell you in the app before it takes effect. The date at the top shows when they last changed.

sections.heading: Law and disputes
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of Uganda. If you have a complaint, please contact us first at hello@domease.app so we can try to put it right. If we cannot agree, the courts of Uganda will decide.
